name: Jöns Jacob Berzelius
summary: Swedish chemist, discoverer of elements, theorist of stoichiometry and chemical atomism, and author of influential chemistry textbooks.

name: Friedrich Wöhler
summary: German chemist, official spokesman for Berzelius in Germany and translator of his textbook.

name: Eilhard Mitscherlich
summary: German naturalist and chemist who studied in Stockholm and corresponded with Berzelius.

name: Gerardus Johannes Mulder
summary: Dutch physician and chemist who translated Berzelius's textbook and corresponded with him.

name: Wilhelm Hisinger
summary: Swedish naturalist and industrialist who patronized Berzelius's laboratory.

name: Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
summary: Swedish academy founded in 1739 where Berzelius served as perpetual Secretary.

name: Uppsala University
summary: Swedish university where Berzelius studied medicine.

name: Lärbok i Kemien
summary: Berzelius's influential chemistry textbook, translated into multiple languages.

name: Årsberättelse om Framstegen i Physik och Kemi
summary: Berzelius's annual reports on the progress of physics and chemistry.

name: Stockholm
summary: Capital of Sweden, location of Berzelius's laboratory and the Academy.
